messages:
maria: Pushed draft relnotes for v0.9.4 (PR #4123). Need quick sweep: SDK snippets, embed-streaming migration note, and Known Issues blurb. Can folks review before EOD?
sam: Ill scan snippets now. Do we still call out the streaming removal date?
maria: yes, short clear note + a tiny migration example. Update Go/Python to client.embed.
alex: Ill update Python snippets. What does the new return look like?
liz: runtime harness sample: ```python
resp = client.embed(model='rwd-mini-embed-1', input='doc')
print(resp['embedding'][:8])
```  remove streaming example.
sam: Go snippets updated in branch (commit 5f3a). docs-bot: CI?
docs-bot: CI: docs-lint passed; snippet-tests failed (timeout).
maria: @liz can you re-run snippet-tests? Might be transient token/timeouts.
liz: bumping snippet-test timeout to 10s fixed it locally. Pushing patch.
alex: found broken migration anchor (/v0.8/embeds)  fixed in PR.
maria: Draft Known Issue: "embed-streaming deprecation — streaming endpoint removed 2026-04-01; calls to client.embed_stream return 410. Use client.embed or websocket proxy for streaming tokens (migration guide link)."
sam: add graceful fallback snippet to notes so customers can auto-fallback.
maria: added: ```js
try { await client.embed_stream(...); } catch (e) { if (e.status === 410) { await client.embed(...); } else { throw e; } }
```
liz: internal note: Dedicated customers on older runtimes will be auto-migrated; include enterprise-support@redwood.ai contact.
sam: want this merged by 17:00 PT. Ill +1 if tests green.
maria: tagging release lead @alex for wording sign-off.
alex: sign-off pending docs-bot green.
docs-bot: CI: all checks passed. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.prod.redwood.ai/rc/0.9.4/docs-relnotes
maria: preview looks good. small nit fixed (KV cache hyphenation).
sam: pushed final tiny fixes. merging at 16:45 PT. :tada:
